subject: CS352
filterSummary: Selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The English selection provided strong candidates for all topics. For Arabic, there was a notable gap in content for 'Applying Usability Heuristics', where no relevant videos were found. For two other Arabic topics, exceptions to the view count rule were necessary to select the most relevant, albeit less popular, videos.

coverage.note: Most candidates were implementation-focused. Selected the most relevant video, which was below the 3000-view gate but permissible by exception as higher-view videos were irrelevant.
